sloka: त्वया विरहितः च अहम् त्यक्ष्ये जीवितम् आत्मनः ।इति इव विलपन् रामः सीता दर्शन लालसः ॥३-६१-११॥
transliteration: tvayā virahitaḥ ca aham tyakṣye jīvitam ātmanaḥ ।iti iva vilapan rāmaḥ sītā darśana lālasaḥ ॥3-61-11॥

translations.english: Deeply distressed, Rama who was anxious to see Sita, daughter of Janaka, wailed and wailed but could not see her.
